title: Smoky Okonomiyaki Cabbage Tacos
description: A fusion of Japanese okonomiyaki and Mexican flavors in a crispy taco shell. Caramelized cabbage and smoky sauce add a sweet and savory twist to traditional tacos.

ingredients.name: vividly
ingredients.amount: 1/4 cup, vividly red cabbage slaw (see notes)

instructions: Caramelize the cabbage in a pan over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add the crumbled okonomiyaki and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the Japanese rice vinegar and smoky sauce.
Add the vividly red cabbage slaw to the bowl and toss to combine.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the cabbage and okonomiyaki mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a spoonful of the slaw and a sprinkle of cheese.
Serve with a dollop of sour cream on top.
